# R7-E1 readout: external Qwen2.5-VL baselines as a separate host column (generated by scripts/r7_e1_readout.py)

E1 columns: an external method's official code in its own pinned env at batch 1 (MMTok @8e26868, HiPrune @8278100) on R7-40c's items, prompts and evaluators; a separate host column, descriptive only — no contrast or test with S1 / S2 / S3 / grid is computed (owner I1, D-E1-7)

Quality in %, 95 % bootstrap CI (image / chart groups, 2,000 replicates, seed 0, shared with R7-40c's rows). S1 / S2 / S3 = mean of the three seed rows. Fractions are nominal: each method keeps its own k (MMTok floor, HiPrune round half to even, R7-40c round half up); realised kept fractions are listed per E1 row.
